Government buildings are even stricter: no shorts, no flip flops, no tank tops. Dress like you mean it. On the flip side, locals are incredibly warm. It is completely normal — and expected — to say good morning and good afternoon to everyone you pass. And in the evening, "goodnight" is a greeting, not a goodbye. Use it when you arrive somewhere, not when you leave. Pharmacies are island-wide. For a proper doctor, Meridian Medical has North American trained physicians. Ladies — the pharmacy across from the Marriott has a doctor onsite for minor things including UTIs, just a quick consultation, no full appointment. After 300+ years they are fully naturalized — part of the ecosystem whether we like it or not. They are wild, they are everywhere, and they are a big reason why we have to import 80%+ of our fruits and vegetables.
